# Intelliprint

Intelliprint offers a Hybrid Mail API that enables businesses to automate their letter printing and mailing processes, providing features like same-day printing, secure authentication, and real-time tracking.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/intelliprint/.

## Actions

- **Cancel or Delete Print Job**: Delete or cancel an existing Print Job by its ID.
- **Create background**: Create a new Background.
- **Create Print Job**: Create a new print job.
- **List Backgrounds** (read-only): List backgrounds with optional filtering and pagination.
- **List Print Jobs** (read-only): List print jobs with optional filters and pagination.
- **List Templates** (read-only): List all available templates.
- **Retrieve Background** (read-only): Retrieve a specific Background by ID.
- **Retrieve Print Job** (read-only): Retrieve details of a Print Job by its ID.
- **Update Background**: Update an existing Background's name or team.
- **Merge Files**: Merge multiple files into one document.
